compiled_notes.title: Semiconductor cycle learning note
key_takeaways: AI data center demand can lift chip suppliers before the effect is visible in every company's reported revenue.
Memory pricing remains cyclical, so a beginner should separate structural AI demand from short-term inventory swings.
Before trusting the trend, inspect source freshness, whether multiple sources agree, and whether the narrative is already crowded.

limitations: Compilation is deterministic local filing, not an investment recommendation.
Raw files are not deleted or moved; inspect source_path before relying on a note.
